name: Weapon illusions whose enchant ID collides with ItemSet.dbc are patched clear of field 8 (#12593)
contract: In Extensions.dll, IsAppearanceCollected (0x10091b90) reads Appearances.dbc field 8 (+0x20) without checking
displayType and looks it up in ItemSet.dbc (0xad3efc). Five APPEARANCE_DISPLAY_TYPE_ITEM_ENCHANT rows have
enchant IDs that collide with ItemSet.dbc entries: 51018 (803), 51022 (853), 51023 (943), 51025 (912, Illusion:
Demonslaying colliding with ItemSet 912 Paladin DT4), and 51046 (854). Because of that collision, the client
requires every piece of the unrelated ItemSet to be collected and shows Illusion: Demonslaying as locked in the
wardrobe even after SMSG_APPEARANCE_ADDED grants 51025. None of the client illusion rendering paths read field 8
(GetAppearanceDisplayInfo reads field 3 for displayID and field 1 for the item name). On login, the server must
send SMSG_PATCH_APPEARANCES (0x0692, opcode 1682) for the 5 colliding illusion rows with field 8 zeroed while
preserving source item, display ID, categories 15/16, and display type, leave non-colliding illusion 51019
(field 8 = 1899) unpatched, and accept applying appearance 51025 to category 15.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: Illusion: Demonslaying (51025) patch clears field 8
Illusion: Demonslaying patch preserves source item 6300508
Illusion: Demonslaying patch preserves enchant visual 912 in field 3
Illusion: Demonslaying patch preserves Main-Hand Illusion category 15
Illusion: Demonslaying patch preserves Off-Hand Illusion category 16
Applying Illusion: Demonslaying to main hand succeeds
